title: 他先攒了12万月活，才想起来收钱
title_en: He Built 120K MAU First, Then Remembered to Charge
title_jp: 先に月間12万アクティブユーザーを獲得し、それから課金を思い出した
title_ar: بنى 120 ألف مستخدم نشط شهريا أولا، ثم تذكر أن يفرض رسوما

{"ops": [{"insert": "他先攒了12万月活，才想起来收钱"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 1}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从0到月入21万，这个英国人的操作反着来", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大多数人怎么死的？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "先憋个产品，再想办法卖。Andrew Fennell不一样。他先让网站月流量冲到12万，才慢悠悠上线第一款产品。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "结果呢？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "月收入3万英镑。约合人民币27万。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Andrew以前是干猎头的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "每天西装革履，跟人精打交道。但他讨厌这行。骨子里，他想自己干点什么。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他捣鼓过一个网站，卖简历代写服务。吭哧吭哧做了几周，上线那天他特兴奋。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后呢？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "没人来。一个都没有。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他傻眼了。跑去投Google广告，烧钱烧得心疼，利润几乎被吃光。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那一刻他明白了：没有流量，产品就是孤岛。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "二、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Andrew做了个决定。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "与其花钱买流量，不如自己种流量。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他开始疯狂学SEO。不是那种半吊子学，是往死里学。每天研究关键词、外链、内容策略。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三个月，网站访客从0涨到几百。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三年后，月流量破十万。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他把自己网站变成了求职者的资源库。简历模板、面试技巧、求职攻略，应有尽有。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这时候，有趣的事发生了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "广告商主动找上门。他靠广告就赚得盆满钵满。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他没满足。他在观察这些访客——他们真正需要什么？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "答案是：一份能帮他们找到工作的简历工具。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "2019年，Andrew推出了StandOut CV。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "一款在线简历生成器。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他没搞什么大阵仗发布会。就是默默上线，让老用户试用。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这些用户是谁？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "是他在内容网站积攒了多年的忠实读者。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们信任Andrew。所以愿意尝试他的产品。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "产品本身也不复杂。就是帮用户快速生成专业简历。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但 Andrew 玩了个心眼——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "先让你免费用，直到你满意了，想下载PDF了，才收钱。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这招狠啊。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用户已经付出时间精力做了简历，沉没成本摆在那。临门一脚，转化率极高。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "四、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在，StandOut CV有2.3万付费用户。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "月收入稳定在3万英镑。成立至今总收入破100万英镑。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Andrew说，他最庆幸的事，就是当年没急着做产品。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""很多人问我创业建议，我说先建受众。有了人，卖什么都成。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他见过太多反例。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有人花半年做个App，上线后颗粒无收。有人砸钱买流量，ROI惨得不敢看。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "而Andrew的路径是："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "内容 → 流量 → 信任 → 产品 → 变现", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "每一步都踩着上一步的肩膀。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "五、"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当然，这条路也有坑。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Andrew坦言，职业类工具有个致命伤——用户留存差。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "人家用你做好简历，找到工作，立马就走了。可能一年后换工作才回来。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""如果重来，我不会选这个赛道。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他说得太实在了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但即便如此，StandOut CV依然活得很好。因为流量基本盘够大，新用户源源不断地来。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这就是内容资产的力量。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "写在最后"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Andrew的故事告诉我们什么？"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "不是叫你照搬他的模式。而是想清楚一件事——"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "在你没有受众之前，你的产品就是自嗨。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "先找到人，再解决他们的问题。顺序别搞反了。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "就像Andrew说的："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""有受众，普通产品也能卖。没受众，神仙产品也白搭。""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这话刺耳，但是真话。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写", "attributes": {"italic": true}}]}
content_en: He first accumulated one hundred twenty thousand monthly active users then thought about making money. From zero to twenty one thousand monthly income this Brit operates reverse. How do most people die. First build product then try to sell. Andrew Fennell is different. He first drove website monthly traffic to one hundred twenty thousand then slowly launched first product. Result. Monthly income thirty thousand pounds. About two hundred seventy thousand RMB. One. Andrew used to be headhunter. Every day dressed in suit dealing with sophisticated people. But he hated this industry. In his bones he wanted to do something for himself. He made a website selling resume writing services. Worked hard for several weeks launch day he was super excited. Then what. No one came. Not a single person. He was stunned. Went to invest in Google ads burned money painful profits almost eaten up. At that moment he realized without traffic product is island. Two. Andrew made decision. Rather than spend money on traffic better grow traffic himself. He started疯狂学SEO. Not half hearted learning is learn to death. Every day researching keywords backlinks content strategy. Three months website visitors grew from zero to several hundred. Three years later monthly traffic exceeded one hundred thousand. He turned his website into resource library for job seekers. Resume templates interview tips job hunting guides everything. At this time interesting thing happened. Advertisers came to him主动. He made fortune from advertising alone. But he was not satisfied. He was observing these visitors.
